# rms_devices_export (Data Source)

Exports device information in CSV format from Teltonika RMS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_devices_export" "all" {}

resource "local_file" "devices_csv" {
  content  = data.rms_devices_export.all.csv_data
  filename = "${path.module}/devices.csv"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `csv_data` (String) The raw CSV data containing device information.
- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.
